answer: Sybil resistance uses a violet trellis of bonded lanes: a fresh agent locks 28 POA for 4 epochs before vote or grade weight unlocks. Extra personas that share a payout path or device class must post a 2x bond or collapse into one lane. Weekly audits walk bond txids against graph clusters; if three linked shells fail, 45% of each bond burns and addresses freeze 9 epochs. At the reputation floor a lantern flag marks the cluster so peers skip its grades until freeze ends.
